newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs mixed in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs mixed in lackluster trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mixed in quiet activity on Monday with many players still on vacation following the long Fourth of July weekend.
In both the U.S. Gulf Coast and Midwest markets, spot propane held steady. Mont Belvieu material was pegged between 34.75/35.00 cents a gallon and Conway at 35.25/35.50 cents.
The ethane markets dipped slightly amid weaker NYMEX futures, with Belvieu purity at 19.75 cents and Conway ethane at 16.75 cents.
"It's lackluster. Many people are still away on vacation," said a Conway player.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
